about: Public keys only. A two-floor descent (stage-exit-scenarios.py `descent`): Monstro on Basement I, Larry Jr. on Basement II, then the shared exit into Caves I. route: the production-recorded walk from gameplay-start into Monstro room 0 (boss-route-record.mjs); a fresh original follows it with zero drift. originalFight: the original's own keys from boss-room-arrival to the bottom-left corner of Basement II's boss room, found once by a research controller (projected-shot dodging) and replayed open-loop: the Monstro kill, its trapdoor, the production-recorded Basement II walk through rooms 7 -> 8 -> 0, the Larry Jr. kill and the corner hold (S+A 60 frames, released, one frame). A fresh original replays it to the same state. descent: each floor's boss room chain and the original's health after its fight, which the next floor's generation reads (a Challenge room needs full health); the port, which fights with its own keys, takes one blast of its own bomb when it ends a fight at full health. Basement II room 8 authors a slot machine (6.1) at cell 67 whose body blocks the player in both games. The original's walk (recorded on the port when the routing grid did not yet count slot bodies as solid, with cells 52/67/82 avoided by hand) passes it in column 8; the port's own walk now routes around the cell the machine's body reaches. Basement II's Larry Jr. room authors rocks on the trapdoor and pedestal cells (37, 97); the award breaks them (fix_award_pos Destroy(1)). originalSolid: the cells still solid in the original after its fight (authored rocks and Larry Jr. tail poops). originalPickups: the hearts the original's fight leaves on the floor; the shared walk keeps off them. No curse on stages 1-4 for this seed (fresh-profile Level::Init roll).
